projects.title: Rest Countries Explorer
projects.shortDescription: A responsive country explorer with live REST API data, search, region filtering, country details, border-country navigation and persistent dark mode.
projects.description: A vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript project that consumes the countries.dev countries API and turns country data into searchable, filterable cards with dedicated country detail views.
features: Fetches country data from the countries.dev REST API
Search countries by name or native name
Displays population, region, sub-region, capital, TLD, currencies and languages
Responsive layout for desktop, tablet and mobile
projects.problem: Country data can be difficult to browse efficiently when presented as raw API responses.
projects.solution: Provides a responsive UI that transforms API data into searchable country cards and detailed country pages with filtering, navigation and theme persistence.
engineeringDecisions: Kept the project framework-free with semantic HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript
Separated listing and country-detail logic into script.js and country.js
Used URL query parameters to identify the selected country
Used localStorage to persist the selected theme
challenges: Handling asynchronous country data before rendering the UI
Mapping API data into reusable country cards and detail fields
Handling missing country fields with fallback values
learnings: Working with REST API responses in vanilla JavaScript
futureImprovements: Add pagination or lazy rendering for large country lists
Add stronger API error and loading states
Add accessibility-focused keyboard and screen-reader refinements

projects.title: Foodie Hamburger
projects.shortDescription: A responsive food landing page featuring burger collections, smooth section navigation and a mobile hamburger menu.
projects.description: A responsive food-focused landing page built with semantic HTML and CSS, with JavaScript-powered mobile navigation and anchored sections for different burger collections and deals.
projects.problem: Presenting multiple food collections in a single responsive landing page while keeping navigation simple across desktop and mobile layouts.
projects.solution: Built a responsive single-page food interface with anchored navigation, dedicated food sections and a JavaScript-controlled mobile menu.
engineeringDecisions: Used semantic HTML sections for the landing-page content
Used CSS media queries for responsive navigation and typography
Used vanilla JavaScript to open and close the mobile navigation menu
challenges: Designing navigation that works across desktop and mobile breakpoints
Keeping large food imagery responsive across screen sizes
Handling mobile menu open and close interactions
learnings: Responsive CSS layouts and media queries
DOM event handling with vanilla JavaScript
futureImprovements: Add individual product cards with pricing and CTA actions
Add accessible keyboard navigation for the mobile menu
Add optimized image loading and modern image formats

projects.title: Focus on Today
projects.shortDescription: A simple daily goal-tracking web app with progress tracking, completion states and reset functionality.
projects.description: A focused productivity app built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript that lets users enter three daily goals, mark them complete and track progress visually.
features: Validation when goals are not fully entered
projects.problem: Daily tasks can become difficult to track when there is no simple visual indication of progress.
projects.solution: Provides a minimal three-goal daily checklist with completion states, a progress bar and a reset flow.
engineeringDecisions: Used semantic HTML with a small, framework-free structure
Used vanilla JavaScript DOM event listeners for goal completion and reset behavior
Used CSS transitions and keyframe animation for visual feedback
Kept the interface responsive with a mobile breakpoint
challenges: Preventing progress updates until all three goals are entered
Keeping completed goal state and progress count synchronized
Resetting inputs, completion states and progress consistently
learnings: Conditional UI state with CSS classes
futureImprovements: Add editable goal deletion and reordering
